# Leexi

AI notetaker - Transcribe, analyse and summarize your calls and meetings.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/leexi/.

## Actions

- **Create Meeting Event**: Create a new meeting event in Leexi with timing, participants, and recording preferences.
- **Get Call** (read-only): Get details of a specific call or meeting by UUID from Leexi.
- **Get Meeting Event** (read-only): Retrieve a specific meeting event by UUID from Leexi.
- **List Calls** (read-only): List all calls and meetings in your Leexi workspace with pagination support.
- **List Meeting Events** (read-only): List all meeting events in your Leexi workspace with pagination support.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List all teams in your Leexi workspace with pagination support.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in your Leexi workspace.
- **Delete Meeting Event**: Delete a specific meeting event by UUID.
- **Request Presigned URL**: Request a presigned URL for uploading a call recording before creating the call.
